question: CJHF and HOMK are related to each other in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, SZXV and XECA are related to each other. Which of the following is related to DLTR, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e728c8ea282532f997ee995c4511634897689d7ff3c9cf33a64565594704b913.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fff5a0fb92dad9e4a54937afe09c68d3a0a30267670783ca6078c98dcf490acb.png]

Similarly, for DLTR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef7b17f4b9c662f8210c10d002fe9f823124783533cc3cacdb443b673e988c95.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62541c5ad08163dd88e1e1927ffe21e51fa0268805296003b66b8f0ff7bc0fdf.png]
